tips.text: Fire Volley from a distance so minions and frontliners in front of you don't soak up the arrows.
Aim Enchanted Crystal Arrow in the direction the enemy is running, so it is more likely to land. A far-away hit stuns for longer.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step up, and again before a fight in the jungle.
Keep attacking to build four stacks, then use Ranger's Focus for fast extra damage in a trade.
Chase and kite with Frost Shot; enemies hit are slowed, so stay at range and keep hitting.
Stay near your support and don't wander alone; Ashe has few ways to escape a gank.
Fire Volley at Aphelios when he steps up to last-hit, and stand back so minions don't soak the arrows.
Aphelios has no dash or escape on his own, so hit him with Enchanted Crystal Arrow when he is pushed up or caught out.
Check the bushes with Hawkshot before you walk up, so you see the enemy jungler coming.
Keep your attacks on him so Frost Shot keeps him slowed and easier to chase or escape from.
Stay out of Sear range and sidestep it. Brand needs to land one spell to start his combo, and the fireball stops at the first unit it hits.
Fire Volley at Brand when he steps up to cast. It does good damage and slows him, which makes it harder for him to line up his next spell.
Stand away from your minions and your support. Conflagration spreads to nearby units, and it spreads twice as far from a target that is ablaze.
Keep Volley aimed at Brand, not at the minions in front of him. The arrows are blocked by the first enemy they hit.
Once Brand's Pyroclasm is on cooldown after level 6, push in and trade. Enchanted Crystal Arrow can also catch him if he walks forward to cast.
Move away from your support when Brand casts Pyroclasm. The fireball starts slowly, so you have time to react.
Stay out of Caitlyn's long reach; her Headshot range is much longer against anyone she has trapped or netted. Don't walk onto a Yordle Snap Trap.
Hold Volley until the enemy is in a straight line with no minions in front. Minions block the arrows.
Look in the brush with Hawkshot before you step up. Caitlyn can hide there and her Headshot comes faster from brush.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Caitlyn when she is rooted or slowed, or when she is far from you. A long flight means a longer stun.
Once Caitlyn fires her net, she has less escape. Go after her then.
Stay at long range and poke with Volley when Cassiopeia steps up to last-hit; she has no way to close the gap quickly.
Keep minions out of the line before firing Volley, because the first enemy hit absorbs each arrow.
Walk sideways out of Noxious Blast as it lands; it explodes after a short delay.
Use Hawkshot on the bushes before you step up, and ping the jungle so your jungler can come for a gank.
If Cassiopeia is facing you when she is about to cast Petrifying Gaze, keep your distance, since you will be stunned.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Cassiopeia from far away when she commits to a fight; the stun gets longer with distance.
Hit Corki with Volley when he walks up to last-hit; it slows him and he has few ways to dodge it at range.
Stay behind your minions when Corki has missiles ready. His Missile Barrage splashes, so hiding is not enough, and you should stay out of its range.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step in; Corki's Phosphorus Bomb poke is easier to avoid when you see him coming.
Punish Corki right after he uses Valkyrie to jump in. He is exposed then, so hit him with Volley and your attacks.
Look for Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Corki when he dashes in or chases you. A long shot stuns him for a long time.
Hold Volley until Draven steps up to attack; the arrows slow him and hit hard if he is alone in front of you.
Keep minions between you and Draven's Stand Aside only if you can; stay out of its line so you are not knocked away from your wave.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Draven from far away when he commits to a fight; a long flight means a long stun.
Attack Draven while his axes are in the air and he is busy catching them; your Frost Shot slow makes him miss the catch.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you walk up, so a gank or Draven's all-in does not surprise you.
Hit Ezreal with Frost Shot attacks to keep him slowed; he can't easily line up Mystic Shot while you chase him back.
Fire Volley when minions are out of the way. The first enemy hit blocks the arrows, so stay back if minions are in front of you.
Ezreal is fragile and has few ways to stop a dive. Use Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away on him after he uses Arcane Shift, and kill him.
Send Hawkshot into the brush before you step forward, so you can see Ezreal and your jungler's ganks coming.
Stay behind your minions when Ezreal's Mystic Shot is ready; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Stay out of the line of Devastating Fire; it is a fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and Hwei.
Walk sideways when Hwei is setting up a spell. His Torment spells need aiming and take time, so unpredictable movement makes them miss.
Hit Hwei with Volley right after he casts a Torment spell. He has to wait on cooldown, so you can also walk up and attack him.
Stay near your support and your minions. Hwei's lightning bolt hurts far more when you are alone or can't move.
Use Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Hwei when he is far away or retreating. Aim it where he is walking, since it stuns for longer over a long distance.
Check the brush with Hawkshot before you walk up, so Hwei can't catch you with an unseen spell.
Hit Jhin with Frost Shot when he walks up to last-hit; he is slowed and has to stop shooting or back off.
Trade while Jhin is reloading after his fourth shot, because he cannot attack then.
Watch for bushes and ground where Jhin may have placed a Captive Audience trap. Don't chase him over unwarded ground.
Stay out of line with Jhin's Deadly Flourish when an ally has just hit you; being rooted there gets you killed.
Fire Volley at Jhin when no minions stand between you, since the first enemy hit absorbs each arrow.
Use Hawkshot to check bushes before you step forward, so Jhin cannot surprise you.
Use Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Jhin from far away when he is channeling Curtain Call or has just fired. A long flight gives a long stun.
Fire Volley at Jinx when she steps up to last-hit; it slows her and she has few ways to answer. Stay at long range so minions don't soak the arrows.
Trade hard once Jinx has missed with her chompers, since she struggles to escape without Flame Chompers!
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step forward. It also shows you where Jinx is when she hides.
Aim Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Jinx when she is low on health or caught out of position. A long flight gives a longer stun, so a kill is easy to follow up.
Keep hitting Jinx with attacks to keep her slowed. A slowed Jinx struggles to get into range or dodge Ranger's Focus.
Use Volley to poke Kai'Sa when she steps up to last-hit; she is slowed and has to back off.
Keep Volley aimed past the minions, because the first enemy hit blocks the arrows. Step to a clear angle first.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away when Kai'Sa dashes in with Killer Instinct. A long flight means a long stun.
Place Hawkshot in the brush before Kai'Sa walks in. She picks off lone targets, so you want to see her coming.
Stay out of Icathian Rain range when you can. She needs a nearby enemy to cast it, and it hurts most when you are alone.
Hit Kalista with Volley when she dashes in to attack; it slows her, and slowed attack speed cuts how far she can hop.
Keep Volley aimed at Kalista rather than at minions in front, since the first enemy hit absorbs each arrow.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step up; Kalista can poke from there with her spears.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Kalista or her partner when they jump in with Fate's Call; the stun gives your team time to kill them.
Trade with Frost Shot attacks when Kalista has just used Pierce; her slowed movement makes it hard for her to dodge back.
Stay out of Lay Waste range and keep to the sides of the lane; it hits hardest when only one enemy is in the blast.
Hold Volley for when Karthus steps forward to last-hit; it hurts and leaves him slowed.
Fire Volley from a distance, with no minions in front of you, so the minions do not absorb the arrows.
Karthus has no escape, so Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away can set up a kill for your team.
Do not stand on a dead Karthus; he can keep casting Defile and Lay Waste for a few seconds after he dies.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step up, and watch for Wall of Pain that slows you.
Poke Kog'Maw with Volley when he steps up to last-hit. He has no escape, so keep the pressure on.
Aim Volley so minions are not in the way, because the first enemy hit absorbs each arrow.
Stay out of the line of Caustic Spittle and Void Ooze. Standing in the ooze leaves you slowed.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away at Kog'Maw. He cannot escape it, and a long flight gives a long stun.
Back off from Kog'Maw's Bio-Arcane Barrage while it is active, because it gives him extra range and hits you with extra damage.
Move away from the spot where Kog'Maw dies. Icathian Surprise explodes on anyone standing close.
Trade with Frost Shot attacks when Lucian steps up to last-hit; he is slowed and has a hard time chasing or escaping.
Fire Volley when Lucian dashes in to trade. His Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze need lining up, and Volley punishes him for standing close.
Keep minions out of the line when you cast Volley, because the first enemy hit absorbs the arrows.
Lucian has strong burst but little sustained damage. Stay back after his combo is spent and trade then.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step up, so a ganker does not catch you alongside Lucian.
If Lucian gets low or runs away, hit him with Enchanted Crystal Arrow at long range; the stun lasts longer the farther it flies.
Stay behind your minions so Light Binding hits them first; it only roots the first two enemies it touches.
Lux has no escape, so when you land Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away, your team can kill her easily.
Trade with Volley when Lux steps up to last-hit; it slows her and she cannot easily get away.
Step out of the Lucent Singularity zone, or fight outside it; it slows you and bursts after a short time.
Send Hawkshot into the brush before you walk up to it, to check for Lux and a gank.
When Lux aims Final Spark, sidestep the red warning line it shows first.
Walk behind minions when Miss Fortune has Double Up ready. Her shot bounces to hit you from the minion in front.
Fire Volley at her when she walks up for a trade. She has little else to do except dodge it, and it slows her.
Hit Miss Fortune once to cancel her Strut speed boost. After that she is easier to catch and to poke.
Move out of Make It Rain quickly. It reveals the area and slows you, so do not stand in it while she trades.
Look for the moment Miss Fortune uses Bullet Time. Her channel is interrupted if she is stunned, so Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stop it.
Use Hawkshot to check the bushes around the lane before you move up. It shows you if Miss Fortune's team is coming.
Aim Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Nilah when she dashes in or out; a long flight stuns her for longer, and she has no way to block it.
Keep Frost Shot on Nilah so she stays slowed. It makes it harder for her to close the gap on you.
Do not fire Volley at Nilah while Jubilant Veil is up if you can wait; it dodges attacks, so shoot after it ends.
Stay back from Nilah and use Volley when she steps up for minions. Her reach is short before she hits you with Formless Blade.
Use Hawkshot on the brush before you walk up. It shows where Nilah is waiting to dash onto you.
Aim Volley at Samira before she closes in; it slows her, and she cannot easily get in close once she is slowed.
Stay at long range and keep hitting her with Frost Shot; slowed, she has a hard time reaching you.
Do not fire Volley while Samira stands in Blade Whirl; it destroys missiles that enter its area.
Wait for Blade Whirl to be used, then fire Volley or Enchanted Crystal Arrow at her while it is on cooldown.
Samira's Wild Rush needs a target to dash through. Keep minions away from her path, and hold your own escape for when she uses it.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at her from far away when she dives; the stun lasts longer and she cannot finish her combo.
Do not get stunned near Samira at full Style; Inferno Trigger hurts a lot when she can use it on you.
Stay out of Senna's long attack range in lane; Frost Shot slows her only when you are already trading, so do not walk up first.
Fire Volley from a distance so a minion does not soak the arrows, and so Senna is slowed and has to stay back.
Step out of the way of Last Embrace; once it sticks to you the root lands a moment later, so move away before it spreads.
Use Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Senna when she is caught out; she has few ways to escape once stunned.
Check bushes with Hawkshot before you push up, so a Senna gank or Curse of the Black Mist camouflage does not surprise you.
Stay behind your minions. Sivir's Boomerang Blade hurts less after hitting them, and her Ricochet loses value.
Don't fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow while Spell Shield is ready. Make her waste it first.
Bait Spell Shield with a Volley when she is on guard. Her shield is short, so fake it first and fire after it fades.
Sivir pushes the lane fast. Use Hawkshot to watch for ganks and keep your own team safe.
Hit Smolder early with Volley; he is weak before he stacks Dragon Practice, so poke him down and keep him from getting hits on champions.
Stay out of his range. Super Scorcher Breath has shorter range than your attacks, so keep your distance and attack from behind your minions.
Keep your Frost Shot slow on Smolder while you walk back; a slowed target is easier to hit with Volley.
Do not group tightly with your support when Smolder has Achooo! ready, because its explosion hurts everyone near the target.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Smolder when he flies with Flap, Flap, Flap; a stun ends his flight and he is easy prey.
Use Hawkshot to check the brush before you step up, so Smolder's team cannot surprise you.
Your Frost Shot slows Tristana on every auto. Poke her and keep her from walking up.
Fire Volley at Tristana when she goes for a trade. Keep minions out of its path, because the first enemy hit blocks each arrow.
Back off when Tristana puts Explosive Charge on you. Her bomb gets stronger with each hit, so don't let her auto you.
Stay away from her minions, since Explosive Charge also hurts nearby enemies when she kills one.
Don't stand close to Tristana at level 6. Buster Shot hits hard, knocks you back and stuns you.
Use Hawkshot to scout the brush and the river before you push up.
Look for Enchanted Crystal Arrow when Twitch is camouflaged and moving; fire it in the direction he is running so it lands.
Use Hawkshot on the brush around your lane to spot Twitch before he jumps you.
Twitch is fragile, so poke him with Volley whenever he steps up to last-hit.
Keep your distance with Volley so minions in front don't soak up the arrows.
Your attacks keep him slowed with Frost Shot, so chase him when he is low or has used his escapes.
Stay out of Hail of Arrows; the ground it leaves slows you and cuts your healing, which makes you easy to catch.
Keep Volley aimed at Varus while minions are out of the way; the first enemy hit absorbs each arrow.
Step sideways when Varus starts charging Piercing Arrow; it is a long, narrow line and he moves slowly while charging.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Varus when he commits to a fight or runs away; a long flight means a long stun.
Do not stand next to your teammate when Varus is near; Chain of Corruption spreads between nearby champions and roots them.
Use Hawkshot on the brush around lane to spot Varus and his support before they poke or gank.
Stay out of Vayne's Condemn range near walls; being knocked into terrain stuns you and she wins the trade.
Use Volley to poke Vayne when she walks up to last-hit; the arrows slow her so she cannot close the gap easily.
Hold Enchanted Crystal Arrow for when Vayne dives in or runs at you; a long-range hit stuns her for a long time and she is fragile.
Send Hawkshot into the brush before you step up, so Vayne cannot surprise you from it.
Early on, trade with Frost Shot slows and back off, and call your jungler: Vayne is weak before she has items.
Keep your distance from Veigar and poke him with Volley when he steps up to last-hit; he has little way to answer long range.
Watch the cage from Event Horizon. Enemies are stunned only when they touch its edge, so do not walk through the rim.
Walk sideways when Veigar casts Dark Matter at you. It lands after a short delay, so you can step out of the circle.
Stay behind your minions so Baleful Strike hits them first. It only hits the first two enemies in its path.
Hit Veigar with Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away to stun him, then finish him with your team. He is fragile.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow from far away at Xayah. Aim where she is walking, because the stun lasts longer the farther the arrow has flown.
Hold Enchanted Crystal Arrow until Featherstorm is spent. Xayah is untargetable while she is in the air.
Keep Xayah slowed with your attacks so she can't easily walk onto her Feathers. It also makes her an easier target for Volley.
Aim Volley so it reaches Xayah, not the minions in front of her. Minions soak up the arrows.
Use Hawkshot on the brush before you walk up. Xayah can't surprise you from the grass, and your jungler can see her.
Keep Volley for when Yasuo walks toward you; its arrows slow him and deal solid damage if he has no minion in front to absorb them.
Do not rely on Volley or Enchanted Crystal Arrow when Yasuo's Wind Wall is up. It destroys projectiles, so wait for it to drop or fire around it.
Stay back from his minions. Yasuo uses Sweeping Blade on them to close the gap, and your attacks slow him only while you are in range.
Dodge sideways when his Steel Tempest becomes a whirlwind. If it knocks you up, his allies can follow with Last Breath, so keep your team close.
Look for a long-range Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Yasuo once he commits to a fight. A longer flight means a longer stun.
Poke Yunara with Volley when she steps up to last-hit; the arrows leave her slowed and she has few ways to answer from range.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Yunara when she dashes or chases; a long shot stuns her for a long time.
Watch for her Transcend One's Self; she gets a dash and a beam, so stay back from her until it runs out.
Hit her with attacks as she walks up; Frost Shot keeps her slowed so you can kite her.
Send Hawkshot into the brush before you step up, so you can see whether Yunara's team is ready to jump you.
Hit Zeri with Volley while she is close; she is slowed, so she has a harder time staying on you or running away.
Keep attacking Zeri in lane, because Frost Shot slows her and makes her dashes and short attack range harder to use.
Fire Enchanted Crystal Arrow at Zeri from far away when she dashes in or walks toward you. It stuns her for longer the farther it flies.
Send Hawkshot into the brush before you step up, so Zeri cannot surprise you with a dash from the bushes.
Stand behind your minions when you use Volley. Its arrows are blocked by the first enemy they hit.
Stay out of Hexplosive Minefield; the mines slow you and make Ziggs' other abilities much easier to land.
Look for Enchanted Crystal Arrow on Ziggs when he is out of position. A long shot stuns for longer, so fire it from far away.
Trade when Ziggs has just used Bouncing Bomb and Satchel Charge, because both have fairly long cooldowns.
Use Volley to poke Ziggs, and aim it so minions don't absorb the arrows.
Ziggs can use Satchel Charge to hop away from you. Keep your Enchanted Crystal Arrow ready for when he runs.
